responsibility: Provides rustc’s incremental-compilation persistence layer: it defines the on-disk file format and serialized work-product metadata, manages session-cache directories and artifact paths on the filesystem, loads and validates previously persisted dep-graph/query-cache/work-product state for reuse, saves newly produced state and removes obsolete artifacts, handles copying and deletion of cached work-product files, and runs the `#[rustc_clean]` incremental-testing checks so the compiler can safely prepare, publish, and verify incremental session state across compilations.
